augmentation: four groups of equal row count; group 2/3 random comparator rate p=.50 on observed values to approximately match self-mask average rate
choice_rule: select eta from [0.5,1.0,2.0] by mean AP over the four shared validation conditions; ties choose smaller eta; use that eta for random-mask DRO matched control; no final data involved

group_definitions.G0: input train matrix as supplied (already MCAR20 masked)
group_definitions.G1: extra random mask p=.20 on finite non-anchor entries

held_out_protocol: validation mode only; final fixture mode is prohibited until parent follow-up; no validation MNAR cases generated; prediction accepts masked X only
metric: mean average precision over exactly the shared validation conditions: clean, mcar_0.2, mcar_0.4, mar_anchor_x0
